title: Three Weeks and One Short Hook
subtitle: 饮食健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：meat　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 meat 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the butcher ① cut the meat that no housewife in the shop would have weighed, and he said the cutting was the whole of the week. The ② meat, meaning the joint itself and not the hook, ran three weeks and stayed unweighed in the book; meat, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unweighed.

Every ③ cut of meat in that shop had the same short hook beside it, and the ④ meat at the far board, meaning the bone they kept for the children to carry and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Meat, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to weigh; the butcher said the weighing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the meat was the whole of the matter, meaning the food and not the joint. The ⑥ meat, meaning the food and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody weighs; meat, he said, is either something you cut or the only word that means both joint and a food. He said the food is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ meat had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short hook. The ⑧ meat of the whole thing, the butcher wrote in December, was one shop and three weeks of weighing; meat, he said, is either the bone at the far board or the reason you learned to weigh. He said the weighing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ meat I remember is the meat weighed in the ledger, which closed in 1972 and is still weighed as the quietest in the shop. ⑩ Meat, my mother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being weighed; all meat, she said, is a food that has agreed to look like joint. She said the food was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 肉；食用肉（指肉铺里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 肉；食用肉（指那块肉本身，与挂钩相对）
C. 固定搭配：cut the meat 切这块肉
D. n. 肉；食用肉（指留给孩子们啃的那一根那一块）
E. n. 买肉之事（抽象总称，指一处肉铺的肉之事）
F. n. 肉；食用肉（指流水账里写到、被称过的的那一块）
G. n. 荤腥、营养（指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 营养（抽象总称，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cut the meat that no housewife in the shop would have weighed
The meat, meaning the joint itself and not the hook
Every cut of meat in that shop
the meat at the far board
the meat was the whole of the matter
the meat had become a line in a ledger
The meat of the whole thing

answers.why: cut the meat 意为“切这块肉”，1965 年那位屠户把肉铺里没有一位主妇肯称的一块肉做了一遍。
meat 意为“肉；食用肉”，指那块肉本身而不是挂钩，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被称。
meat 意为“肉；食用肉”，指肉铺里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一只小小的挂钩。
meat 意为“肉；食用肉”，指最远那张肉案留给孩子们啃的那一根那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
meat 意为“荤腥、营养”，指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份营养就是那件事的全部。
meat 意为“营养”，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块肉，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
meat 意为“肉；食用肉”，指流水账里写到、被称过的的那一块，到 1970 年这一块成了流水账里的一行。
meat 意为“买肉之事”，屠户十二月写道，整件事的肉之事是一处肉铺和三个星期的称。
meat 意为“肉；食用肉”，我记得的是流水账里称过的那一块，1972 年卖完了，至今仍被说成肉铺里最安静的一块。
meat 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，肉是唯一会因为被好好称而变得更好的肉。
